registration.method: phase correlation of high-pass relief, existing DTM vs USGS controlled DTM (same stereo pair)

albedo.colour: ILLUSTRATIVE ramp: HiRISE RED is a single band

normal.basis: tangent space relative to the DTM smoothed over 3 x 3 cells

groundMask.layout: uint8 brightness (1..255), 0 = no terrain; rows north to south
groundMask.use: runtime clast / pebble scatter near the camera (ILLUSTRATIVE shapes)

rocks.layout: float32 x 6: east, north, up, scale, yawDeg, category
rocks.note: placements driven by HiRISE brightness and DTM slope; shapes ILLUSTRATIVE
